clue.text: Eccentric using hard and soft drugs together

parts.note: crack is a hard drug, a form of cocaine
pot is slang for cannabis, a soft drug

explanation.surface: Someone takes hard and soft drugs at the same time and is thought odd.
explanation.definitionFit: A crackpot is a crank, a wildly eccentric person.

clue.text: Chair for the lounge one may move back to flat

definitions.meaning: an armchair with an adjustable back for lounging

definitions.text: one may move back to flat
definitions.meaning: something that can lean back until lying flat

explanation.definitionFit: A reclining armchair; also anything that tips backwards to lie down.

clue.text: A universally-agreed standard for performance on the field

definitions.meaning: the internationally agreed tuning standard for musical instruments
a pitch, or field, used for a concert performance

explanation.definitionFit: The fixed reference tuning for orchestras, and whimsically a sports ground used for a gig.

clue.text: One full of drink maybe sounded alarm at home

indicators.note: sounded says the word for alarm is heard rather than spelt

parts.note: panic is sudden alarm
in means at home

explanation.surface: A drinker panicked when an alarm went off in the house.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'maybe' marks the definition as an example: the cup holds drink.
explanation.definitionFit: A pannikin is a small metal drinking cup, a vessel that may be filled with liquid.

clue.text: All made to agree

parts.note: to tally is to agree or correspond

explanation.surface: Everyone is forced to fall in line.
explanation.walkthrough: 'made' links: the definition is made from the two pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Totally means wholly, completely, in all respects.

clue.text: Goes down quickly, having time free

parts.note: dives means plunges or drops fast

explanation.surface: A diver plunges rapidly with time to spare.
explanation.definitionFit: To divest is to strip or rid, setting someone free of something.

clue.text: Widespread English tree coming up

indicators.note: in a down clue coming up means the letters read from bottom to top

parts.note: a fir is a conifer tree

explanation.surface: An English tree springs up everywhere.
explanation.definitionFit: Rife means prevalent, common everywhere.

clue.text: Last on catwalk modelling a winter range of clothing

indicators.note: last on catwalk takes the final letter of that word
modelling means shaping, so the following letters are moulded anew

explanation.surface: The final model on a fashion runway shows a winter line.
explanation.definitionFit: Knitwear is the category of knitted garments such as jumpers and cardigans.

clue.text: Lack of oxygen needed by scientific expedition

parts.note: O is the chemical symbol for oxygen
a mission is an expedition sent out with a purpose, such as a scientific one

explanation.surface: A research trip needs oxygen it has not got.
explanation.definitionFit: An omission is a leaving out, something missing, so a lack.

clue.text: Computer symbol one has to read carefully

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
to con is an old verb meaning to study or read attentively

explanation.surface: A computer user must study an on-screen symbol.
explanation.definitionFit: On a screen, a small clickable picture standing for a program is called by this name.

clue.text: Recovering from depression, trail after prisoner

indicators.note: after says the depression and trail come behind the prisoner in the answer

parts.note: con is short for convict, a prisoner
a vale is a valley, a depression in the land
a scent is the trail an animal leaves for hounds to follow

explanation.surface: An escaped convict, recovering, follows a trail out of a valley.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone convalescent is regaining health after illness.

clue.text: Seriously discuss having to reduce noise from battery?

definitions.meaning: an idiom meaning stop chattering and get to the point

definitions.text: having to reduce noise from battery?
definitions.meaning: silencing the clucking of hens kept in a battery farm

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means drop idle talk; literally it means quieting cackling hens.

clue.text: European currency securing a reversible coat

indicators.note: reversible tells us the assembled letters are turned round to read the other way
securing means holding something within, so the single letter goes inside the currency

parts.note: the krona is the currency of Sweden

explanation.surface: Swedish money buys a coat that can be worn either side out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'securing' puts A inside KRONA to make KARONA, and 'reversible' turns that round.
explanation.definitionFit: An anorak is a hooded waterproof jacket, a kind of coat.

clue.text: Toleration of lake's advance in height

indicators.note: advance in says one letter of the word for height moves forward to an earlier place

parts.note: altitude is height above sea level
L is the map abbreviation for lake

explanation.surface: A tolerant view arises when a lake rises in height.
explanation.walkthrough: In ALTITUDE the L moves up to the front, giving LATITUDE.
explanation.definitionFit: Latitude is freedom allowed, a degree of tolerance or leeway.

clue.text: Old man stayed in tending to fuel

indicators.note: stayed in says the father figure remains inside the other word

parts.note: prone to means inclined or tending to
pa is an informal word for father, one's old man

explanation.surface: Dad stayed home looking after the boiler.
explanation.definitionFit: Propane is a gas burned as a heating and cooking fuel.

clue.text: Waiting calmly, as there's no one else to play this game

definitions.text: as there's no one else to play this game
definitions.meaning: the British name for solitaire, a card game for one

explanation.definitionFit: The virtue of calm forbearance; also the card game played alone.

clue.text: Dismiss one taking money.

definitions.meaning: to discharge someone from the armed forces in disgrace
a bank or shop employee who takes in payments

explanation.definitionFit: The verb means expel from service; the noun is the person at the till.

clue.text: A vessel like this making for capital decoration

parts.note: a can is a container, a vessel
thus means in this way

explanation.surface: A boat built like this gives a fine finish to the capital city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'capital' is the top of a column, not a city.
explanation.definitionFit: Acanthus leaves are the carved ornament on Corinthian column tops.

clue.text: Sealing last of herbage for fermentation

definitions.text: Sealing last of herbage for fermentation

indicators.note: fermentation suggests a bubbling agitation, so the letters are stirred up
last of takes the final letter of the word herbage

explanation.surface: Farm work: sealing up the remaining grass so it ferments.
explanation.definitionFit: Ensilage is the storing of green fodder airtight in a silo so it ferments into feed.

clue.text: Considered action about protected species

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the animal sits inside the action

parts.note: a deed is an act or action
bats are a legally protected species in Britain

explanation.surface: A conservation action concerning an endangered animal.
explanation.definitionFit: Debated means discussed or thought over, considered.

clue.text: A number challenge for ball — kick finally warrants sending off, one feels

parts.note: ten is a number

indicators.note: warrants sending off suggests a player dismissed, so a letter is removed from the word

parts.note: a tackle is a challenge for the ball in football or rugby

indicators.note: finally takes the last letter of the word kick

explanation.surface: A football foul in which a late kick deserves a red card.
explanation.walkthrough: The K at the end of 'kick' is sent off from TACKLE, leaving TACLE.
explanation.definitionFit: A tentacle is a feeler, an organ an octopus or snail uses to touch.

clue.text: Class keeping in line in secure place

indicators.note: keeping in means holding within, so the line letter goes inside

parts.note: a caste is a social class

explanation.surface: A school class kept in order inside a safe building.
explanation.definitionFit: A castle is a fortified stronghold.

clue.text: From what Zola wrote, judge dropped charge

indicators.note: dropped means the letter for judge is removed from the title

parts.note: J'accuse was Emile Zola's open letter on the Dreyfus affair

explanation.surface: Inspired by Zola's famous letter, a judge throws out a case.
explanation.definitionFit: To accuse is to charge someone with an offence.

clue.text: Cuisine that's specially hot

indicators.note: specially suggests letters arranged in a special new way

explanation.surface: A restaurant dish made especially spicy.
explanation.definitionFit: To be hot on something is to be keen and eager about it.

clue.text: Offensive vehicle smelt awful, failing to start

indicators.note: failing to start means the opening letter is dropped

parts.note: stank is the past tense of stink

explanation.surface: A tank that stinks is an offensive vehicle in two senses.
explanation.definitionFit: A tank is an armoured fighting vehicle used in attack.

clue.text: Deal hammer-blow — it typically precedes the sack

definitions.meaning: to strike with a hammer, as when shaping flints
in a knapsack the word comes just before sack

explanation.definitionFit: Knapping is hammering stones; it is also the front half of a knapsack.

clue.text: One trapped in trade route by the French mob?

indicators.note: trapped in says the single letter is held inside the waterway

parts.note: a canal is a man-made waterway used for carrying goods
I is the Roman numeral one
le is French for the

explanation.surface: Someone stuck on a French barge route among a rough crowd.
explanation.definitionFit: Canaille is a borrowed French word for the rabble or riff-raff.

clue.text: Get ruffled as daughter is very taken by scoundrel

indicators.note: taken by says the letter is held inside the rogue's word

parts.note: a heel is a contemptible man, a cad

explanation.surface: A father gets flustered when his daughter falls for a rogue.
explanation.definitionFit: To dishevel is to make untidy, to rumple or tousle.
